title: Raise the Bar Open Mic @ Transplants Brewing Company
event_description: All genres welcome including musicians and performers. Music starts at 7pm with signups beginning at 6pm. Hosted by Davemaster Dave bringing energy and community focus to Palmdale's creative scene.
venue_address: 40242 La Quinta Ln Unit 101 Palmdale CA 93551
event_venue_information: Open format open mic welcoming all musicians. Large connected venue space with professional sound system. Diverse entertainment lineup featuring local and touring bands. Inventive craft beers and food trucks available.

title: Open Mic and Talent Show @ Antelope Valley College Palmdale Center
event_description: Annual open mic event showcasing performances from students faculty and staff. Participants can perform for fun or compete for top honors in different categories. Evening of incredible live performances.
event_venue_information: Educational venue hosting community open mic events. College center with performance capabilities. Supportive environment for emerging talent and established performers.
